schema:name: Russ Kramer with the Agronomy Team, Hacienda La Minita
schema:description: This image shows Russ Kramer alongside 3 members of the Agronomy Team of Hacienda La Minita. Hacienda La Minita is a coffee estate in the Los Santos region of Costa Rica, where coffee production is managed from cultivation through final milling. The estate is Distant Lands Coffee’s flagship farm. Russ Kramer, president of Hacienda La Minita and a longtime specialty coffee industry professional, has worked with Hacienda La Minita since 1995, with a focus on coffee quality, traceability, and relationships with growers throughout the global coffee trade.
